t: The Milwaukee Hex Shank Multi-Material Drill Bit is a versatile drilling solution for trade professionals. This 6mm x 150mm drill bit is engineered for efficient penetration across a wide range of building materials, including concrete, brick, wood, metal, and ceramic tiles. Ideal for electricians and general builders, its robust tungsten-carbide tip ensures reliable performance. The 6mm hex shank provides secure driving in impact drivers and 3-jaw chuck machines. Featuring a hardened double-flute design and 90mm working length, it offers efficient debris removal and consistent drilling depth for diverse job site requirements.
b: Suitable for Wide Range of Building Materials, Ceramics & Tiles, Wood, Plastic, Thin Sheet Metals & Aluminium
